The `--no-content` flag is used with `project-scan` to perform a metadata-only scan before delegation. This is useful for quickly understanding the structure and metadata of a project without processing the actual content, which can be helpful for planning or auditing purposes.

The `select-model` command previews the recommended Mistral model before running a task. This allows you to see which model is suggested for a specific task, such as auditing, before actually executing the task with the `run` command.

```powershell
node ~/.codex/skills/mistral-subagent/scripts/mistral-subagent.mjs project-scan --path path/to/project --no-content --max-files 20 --output snapshot.json
```

```powershell
node ~/.codex/skills/mistral-subagent/scripts/mistral-subagent.mjs select-model --task Audit
```
